explanation: The mathematician Edward Kasner asked his young nephew, Milton Sirotta, to name the number. The search company Google later took its name from a play on googol.

claims.text: The name 'googol' for 10 to the power 100 was suggested by Milton Sirotta, the nine-year-old nephew of the mathematician Edward Kasner.
The name googol was not coined by a search company, an ancient Greek or a Victorian banker.
Edward Kasner asked his nephew to suggest a name for the number.
The company name Google is a play on the word googol.
A googol is 1 followed by 100 zeros.
